title: Understanding the Components
text: The expected squared error can be broken down into three main components: variance, bias squared, and irreducible error. Can you identify which part of the equation represents each of these components?

title: Focus on h(x)
text: Consider the role of h(x) in the equation. Is it something that changes with different datasets, or is it a fixed function of $$x$$?

title: Fixed or Variable?
text: When thinking about h(x), should it be treated as a fixed function or a variable one?
